answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 820 aliases needs 820 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The jetty of the seal is the chip, the copper of the quote is the receipt, and the ridge of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
